Name: Koko's Tillable Meadowlands Farm
Author: KokoroIppai
Description:
This farm is exactly what the mod name implies: the base Meadowlands farm, but all tiles are tillable! This is for players that prefer that their farming empire is not limited by the amount of dirt on their farm! Start up a new farm on CA's brand new Meadowlands map, and till to your heart's (and pocket's) content!

[b][i]This mod is only compatible with Stardew Valley v1.6+ on PC.[/i][/b]

[b]To Install:[/b]
1) Download and install all required mods.
2) Unzip the downloaded mod file in to your StardewValley/mods folder.
3) Run the game using SMAPI and start a new save on the Meadlowlands Farm!

Downloads.Description: For SDV v1.6+. Fixed some previously untillable tiles.
